ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, objects A and B are connected through a thin string and a light spring on the two sides of a light pulley fixed on the ceiling. The masses of objects A and B are both m. At the beginning, the thin string is straight; object A is held by hand so that the spring is at its original length and the distance between A and the ground is h, while object B is at rest on the ground. After letting go, object A falls, and when it is about to contact the ground, the magnitude of its velocity is v. At this time, object B happens to exert no pressure on the ground. Then which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The stiffness coefficient of the spring is mg/h

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a light pulley fixed under the ceiling, and a thin string passes over the pulley. The left end of the string is connected to object B, and B is placed on the ground; the right end of the string is connected downward to a light spring, and the lower end of the spring is connected to object A. Object A is suspended above the ground, and the distance from A to the ground is marked as h in the figure. Reasoning: Initially the spring is at its original length, and A is h from the ground. After letting go, when A falls to the point of being about to contact the ground, A has descended h. At this time, the problem says that B happens to exert no pressure on the ground, which indicates that B is still in the critical state of being in contact with the ground, and the position of the left end of the string does not change. Therefore, the string-length relation over the pulley makes the right end of the string, that is, the position of the upper end of the spring, also not change. Thus the h through which A descends is entirely manifested as the elongation of the spring, namely x=h. Force analysis of B in the final state: B is subjected to gravity mg downward, the string tension T upward, and the ground support force N upward. Happening to have no pressure means N=0, and the critical equilibrium condition is T=mg. The light spring and the thin string are connected in series, and the tension in the string equals the elastic force of the spring, so T=kx=kh. From kh=mg, obtain k=mg/h.
